observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: an urban outdoor public plaza with wooden decking flooring and modern buildings in the background
observation.dancers: one main solo male dancer, occasionally accompanied or joined by other young men in group shots
observation.formation_and_space: solo dancer performing in open space, sometimes joined by two or three other dancers standing alongside or moving together
observation.posture: relaxed upright torso, knees slightly bent with a bouncy and agile weight distribution
observation.footwork: fast rhythmic stepping, sliding, quick hops, heel-toe weight shifts, and bounces on the beat; exact foot placement details partially obscured by quick camera cuts and lower resolution
observation.arms_and_hands: arms move dynamically with the rhythm, swinging, gesturing, holding a backpack strap, or extending outward for balance
observation.hips_and_torso: bouncing torso with occasional leaning and crouching movements
observation.levels_jumps_turns: frequent level changes between upright dancing, low crouching stances, squats, floor drops, and quick foot hops
observation.costume_and_props: casual streetwear including t-shirts, caps, hoodies, jeans, cargo pants, and colorful sneakers; backpacks worn by some dancers
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement and rapid micro-steps are obscured by quick editing cuts and lower resolution footage

signature_moments.what: bouncy upright leg stepping with arms swinging to the beat
rapid footwork hopping and sliding on heels
low crouching hop and spin close to the ground
deep wide squat lean with arms gesturing outward
acrobatic floor freeze movement supporting body weight on hands
